name: embed-exploration-bench3
description: A small benchmark suite designed to explore properties of embedding spaces and evaluate embedding-based tasks such as semantic similarity, nearest-neighbor retrieval, and clustering. It provides pairs/triplets and retrieval/clustering evaluation splits to measure how well embeddings capture semantic structure. The benchmark is intended for rapid experimentation with different embedding encoders and similarity metrics.
evaluation_method: Precision@k and Recall@k for retrieval; clustering metrics such as ARI/NMI; average cosine similarity for pairwise tasks
reputation: A small, exploratory dataset on Hugging Face used by practitioners experimenting with embedding methods; limited formal adoption in the wider community.
